read.en: Applied Materials fell 7.5% on Oct 30 to $390.09, trading between $382.62 and $405.20 on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($402.3) and 200-day ($444.5) and the falling 10-day ($399.1), 30-day ($460.0) and 100-day ($509.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($375.89), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月30日下跌 7.5%，收于 $390.09，盘中区间 $382.62–405.20，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价低于上行的 5 日（$402.3）和 200 日均线（$444.5），以及下行的 10 日（$399.1）、30 日（$460.0）和 100 日均线（$509.2）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$375.89），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $426.5 Oct 29 high stopped under $427.7, and the drop broke all three written supports ($390.5–414), now resistance. Resistance is $399.1–405.2 (10 and 5-day, Oct 30 high), then $407.3–409.9 (Oct 16 and Oct 29 lows) and $426.5–427.7. Support is $382.6 (Oct 30 low), then $372.8–377.1 (Oct 23 and Apr 29 lows, SAR). A close above $405.2 would target $410–427; below $372.8, a bearish SAR flip.

s.en: Parabolic SAR $375.9; Apr 29 low $377.1; Oct 23 low $372.8
